item.title: Murmur 1.10
item.description:
A new icon

Murmur's icon is redrawn from scratch. It was a waveform, which every audio app on your Mac already uses — it said "this handles sound" and nothing more. It's now a text caret with sound arriving at it, because what Murmur actually does is put your words where your cursor is. It also stays legible at the small sizes you meet it in, in the Dock and in Finder lists.

Check for Updates, and About

Both are in the menu-bar menu now — click the waveform in your status bar. **About Murmur** shows the version and how to find me, from the app menu too.

Fixes

  • Settings wouldn't open from the menu bar. The window's toolbar had already been

    • fixed; the menu bar kept a second, broken copy. There's one implementation now, so it can't drift again.
